Here’s a quick rundown of the new tools you can use:

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `adjustClimateControl` | Set temperature, fan speed, and mode (auto/cool/heat/defrost). |
| `check_tire_pressure` | Check tire pressure. |
| `displayCarStatus` | Show status for fuel, battery, doors, climate, etc. |
| `display_log` | Display a list of log messages. |
| `estimate_distance` | Estimate distance between two zip codes. |
| `estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage` | Estimate feasibility based on mileage. |
| `find_nearest_tire_shop` | Find the closest tire shop. |
| `get_current_speed` | Get the current speed. |
| `get_outside_temperature_from_google` / `get_outside_temperature_from_weather_com` | Get outside temperature from Google or Weather.com. |
| `get_zipcode_based_on_city` | Convert city name to ZIP code. |
| `lockDoors` | Lock/unlock specific doors. |
